name: Retry on Insufficient Evidence
description: When a researcher loop fails, retry with a broader search strategy. The retry agent receives the failed loop id as a reference — it uses read_loop_result to inspect what the previous attempt produced before choosing a different approach. Bounded by max_iterations + a when guard. See ADR-028.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.retry
on_enter.prompt: A previous research attempt was insufficient. Call read_loop_result with loop id $entity.id to inspect the prior attempt's output, then retry with a broader approach — different search queries, synonyms, adjacent topics. If still thin after a thorough second pass, submit what you found with a note on the gaps.
